moves.label: Quick Demon Jab
moves.description: Fast high demon jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Compact standing strike from Neuro's neutral pose.

moves.label: Demonic Twin Drill
moves.description: Slow mid jumping twin assault with a long active rush and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward rush shows green demonic speed and jump data.

moves.label: Demon Hand Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with long active claw lift and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Raised demonic hand strike is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Green Talon Kick
moves.description: Slow mid talon kick with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Green energy kick lashes forward at body height.

moves.label: Low Mystery Snare
moves.description: Slow low snare feint with extended active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Chain-like snare descends while Neuro stays low.

moves.label: Demonic Tornado Kick
moves.description: Slow low jumping tornado kick that knocks down after extended active spin.
moves.reason: Aerial green kick is authored as low, tornado, jump, and knockdown.

moves.label: Demon Power Crush
moves.description: Quick mid jumping knockdown crush with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Leaping green-energy crush is authored as knockdown.

moves.label: Crouching Demon Blade
moves.description: Fast mid crouching blade rush with long active demonic coverage.
moves.reason: Crouch sequence draws a green blade and rushes forward.

moves.label: Crouch Talon Launcher
moves.description: Fast mid launcher with long active claw lift and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Crouching claw sweep is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Demon Jab
moves.description: Steady high overdrive jab with a brief active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command uses the high demon jab.

moves.label: Demon Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown drive with very long active demonic pressure.
moves.reason: Aura drive is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: While-Rising Demon Claw
moves.description: Fast mid while-rising claw with long active pressure and steady recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising command claws upward through mid space.

moves.label: Ducking Demon Jab
moves.description: Steady high ducking jab with a brief active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the high demon jab.

moves.label: Demon Flight Rush
moves.description: Fast mid jumping rush with very long active demonic pressure.
moves.reason: Forward command floats into a green rush and has jump data.

moves.label: Demon Rush Jab
moves.description: Steady high rush jab with a brief active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab uses the high demon jab.
